title: VideoGame Platform · Catalogue synchronization
description: Manual, sparse synchronization events. Instant totals and means are the latest observed application-process accumulation, not totals in the selected range or one run. The history panel shows retained cumulative samples. Use the management last-run report for an individual run; missing is not zero. After restart, previous lazy outcome meters may remain at the Collector for up to five minutes until expiry.

panels.title: Runs by outcome · observed process totals
panels.description: Exact observed cumulative completed/skipped run count by outcome since the application process started. Includes the first exported event; does not extrapolate an integer count. An outcome without a meter is absent, not an invented zero. This is not a total for the selected seven-day range.

panels.title: Mean reported run duration · process
panels.description: Cumulative timer sum divided by completed/skipped run count, per outcome, since process start. A single observation gives that run duration; several give their weighted mean. Use the durable last-run report for one execution. Skipped commands may be very short; no percentile is available. Skipped commands have a response/log but do not replace the durable last-run report.

panels.title: Catalogue work by kind · process totals
panels.description: Exact accumulated record amounts reported after completed/skipped runs. Summary sum counts records; summary count counts reports. A recorded zero (for example no created records on an unchanged rerun) is valid. A missing series means no report for that kind has been exported; not in-flight progress or one run.

panels.title: Provider requests · process totals
panels.description: Exact observed cumulative logical provider calls by closed operation/outcome, including work in progress. One call can include retries; retry attempts are separate. Failure outcomes absent from the registry mean none has been observed in this process, not a fabricated zero or proof of delivery health.

panels.title: Mean provider call duration · process
panels.description: Cumulative elapsed time divided by logical provider call count, per operation, since process start. Includes failed calls and adapter work/retry waits within the timed call. A high mean suggests slow calls; it is not the last call or a percentile. No calls means no mean.

panels.title: Provider retries · process totals
panels.description: Exact cumulative extra attempts by operation. The adapter registers a retry counter even for a successful call with zero retries, so a present zero is meaningful. A missing operation means no corresponding call metric has arrived. Increasing retries suggest transient provider/rate-limit trouble; inspect the run report/logs.

panels.title: Mapping failures · process totals
panels.description: Exact cumulative rejected provider mappings by bounded reason. These meters are registered lazily only when a mapping failure occurs. No series is legitimate when none has occurred, provided OTLP/scrape health is verified. Do not replace absence with zero; deferrals and persistence failures are different signals.

panels.title: Retained run-counter observations
panels.description: Historical cumulative counter samples in the selected range, not a count of runs in that range. Stair steps show observed increments; restarts reset counters and may leave a gap. A first event may precede the first sample. Old samples survive in Prometheus, but cannot reconstruct exact lifetime/per-run totals across unseen resets. Latest totals above use instant queries.
